Native RADDet/CARRADA simulation and calibration workflows

positional arguments:
  {inspect,prepare,candidates,calibrate,gain,generate,validate,run}
    inspect             Read actual native tensors and draw coordinate/label
                        overlays

                        Cartesian/native annotations
    candidates          Propose unconfirmed point-target/noise regions and
                        write visual diagnostics
    calibrate           Measure PSF/noise from selected TRAIN frames,

    gain                Optional unlabeled training-only relative power-

    validate            Compare held-out real/synthetic distributions and

                        assumptions
